title: finding(multi-package): the machine-locale `Intl` class lives outside `packages/plugin-detail` too — a comment-masked scan returns sites across ~13 packages, and the raw count OVER-reports because at least one read site is a deliberate fallback
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#9786

<sub>⬆️ Added by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) when the census came back: the table is delivered, and what remains waits on that card's unruled gate question. Rationale and readings in the verdict comment; ⛔ nothing else in this body was touched.</sub>

`useDisplayLocale` (`packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts`) states in its own doc comment the one thing a caller must not do — reach past the hook and hand `Intl` the `undefined` it gets on an unconfigured workspace, because `undefined` means **the MACHINE's locale**, which is neither channel.

objectui#9786 repaired that class inside `packages/plugin-detail` (**10** sites across 9 files, PR objectui#9905). ⚠️ **The class does not stop at that package.**

## What was measured, and what was ⛔ NOT

⭐ A **comment-masked** scan of the repository's non-test sources returns machine-locale call sites across **`app-shell`, `apps/console`, `fields`, `plugin-charts`, `components`, `core`, `plugin-chatbot`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-report`, `collaboration`, `plugin-ai`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-designer`**.

⛔ **No site was read for intent, and the raw count OVER-REPORTS.** The one hit that *was* read proves it:

```ts
// packages/collaboration/src/CommentThread.tsx
catch { return date.toLocaleDateString(); }
```

⇒ that is a **deliberate fallback** for a tag `Intl` itself rejected, ⛔ **not** this defect. ⚠️ Repairing it would be the defect.

⇒ ⭐ **this card's first deliverable is the READ, ⛔ not the count.** A number here is a list of candidates, and objectui#9786 measured that the difference between a candidate and a site is a human judgement about intent.

## ⚠️ Three instrument lessons objectui#9786 paid for — carry them in

**① ⛔ A raw grep counts PROSE as code.** The originating card reported 「11 sites」; re-derived with comments masked it is **9 code + 2 lines of one file's doc comment**. ⭐ This repo already has the single declared answer — `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` — plus `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs` guarding against re-rolling it. ⇒ **use it.**

**② ⛔ A source scan CANNOT see the whole class.** The tenth site in `plugin-detail` was `HistoryTimeline.tsx` passing an optional **prop** that no caller ever supplied — `new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(locale, …)` with `locale` `undefined` at runtime. ⛔ No grep of any shape sees that. ⭐ objectui#9786's pin solves it with a **runtime tripwire**: it patches `Intl.DateTimeFormat` / `NumberFormat` / `RelativeTimeFormat` / `ListFormat` / `PluralRules` / `Collator` and `Date.prototype.toLocale*` during each render and inspects **the argument each call actually received** — seeing through variables, defaults and spreads. That instrument is reusable and is the one to copy.

⚠️ ⭐ And that site's own doc comment **declared the defect in words** — 「Locale used for relative time formatting. **Defaults to browser locale.**」 (`HistoryTimeline.tsx:61`, seat-verified on `origin/main` `c1f039a6`) — and sat there through **five** closures of this class.

**③ ⚠️ A CONTROL DECAYS.** The originating card cited `DetailView.tsx`'s two `Intl.NumberFormat(undefined` sites as its lit control. Seat-verified today: that probe now returns **0** there, because PR objectui#9777 landed and all four of that file's sites read `displayLocale`. ⇒ ⛔ **anyone re-running the card's probe today cannot tell a broken query from a clean file.** Pick a control that a repair cannot extinguish, or re-establish it each time.

## ⚠️ The question underneath, which this card does ⛔ NOT answer

⭐ **This class has been closed SIX times on six file surfaces** — objectui#4541, #4553, #4566, #4576, #9453 and now #9786 — **and reappeared every time**, because each repair was scoped to whatever card was in flight.

⇒ carding the thirteenth package is doing the seventh. ⚠️ Whether a **repo-wide instrument** should exist is a separate, live question, and it is **人工地板** (a new gate) ⇒ ⛔ not this card's and ⛔ not any execution seat's. It sits on objectui#9786.

⇒ **the honest framing of THIS card**: it is the population, read for intent, package by package — and it should be **sequenced after** that decision, ⛔ not ahead of it, or it becomes the seventh instance of the pattern it documents.

## Dedupe words

- `machine locale toLocaleString undefined`
- `Intl undefined display locale sibling packages`
- `useDisplayLocale bypassed outside plugin-detail`
- `toLocaleDateString no argument package sweep`
- `comment-masked machine locale census`
